items.title: Pflichtpraktikum Produktentwicklung (all genders)
items.snippet: Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern verstehen, wie aus einer Idee ein Produkt wird, das Kund:innen wirklich nachkaufen? Die MainTea GmbH ist ein Food-Startup aus Frankfurt am Main mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und Teil der MainTea-Gruppe. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Marken: Besser im Glas (D2C), PRO2BE , Bubble Pop und Bubble Chill , jeweils im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Deine Aufgaben Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken. Verkostung & Produkttests: Du planst und organisierst strukturierte Verkostungen, wertest Geschmack, Aroma, Textur und Optik aus und lieferst Feedback, das direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt. Trendrecherche & Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Food- und Getränketrends im Blick, beobachtest Wettbewerber im Onlinehandel und im Supermarkt und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Sorten und Konzepte ein. Rezeptur-Support: Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Produktentwicklungen und pflegst Rezepturen und Produktdaten. Lieferanten & Muster: Du fragst Rohstoffe, Muster und Angebote bei Herstellern und Co-Packern an, vergleichst sie und behältst den Überblick über laufende Anfragen. Produktdaten & Kennzeichnung: Du unterstützt beim Erstellen von Spezifikationen, Zutatenlisten und Etikettentexten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Qualitätsmanagement und Grafik zusammen. Besorgungen & Testlogistik: Du besorgst Testzutaten und Vergleichsprodukte und sorgst dafür, dass bei Verkostungen alles bereitsteht. Dokumentation: Du hältst Ergebnisse sauber fest und machst Fortschritte für das Team nachvollziehbar. Dein Profil Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und musst im Rahmen deines Studiums ein Pflichtpraktikum von mindestens 6 Monaten absolvieren. Idealerweise studierst du Ökotrophologie, Ernährungswissenschaften, Ernährungsökonomie, Food Management oder etwas Vergleichbares. Du brennst für Food, neue Produkte und Trends und probierst gern Neues aus. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Geschmack und ein Auge fürs Detail. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und packst gern selbst mit an. Du bist kommunikativ und trittst gegenüber externen Partnern professionell auf. Du sprichst gut Deutsch und Englisch (unsere Partner sitzen teils im Ausland). Du arbeitest sicher mit MS Office, vor allem Excel. Führerschein Klasse B. Was wir dir bieten Praxis, die zählt: Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1. Du arbeitest an Produktentwicklungen, die wirklich in den Verkauf gehen, nicht an Übungsszenarien. Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden: An drei Tagen pro Woche kocht unsere Köchin frisch für das Team-Lunch, weil gutes Essen dazugehört. Team & Kultur: Ein offenes, vertrauensvolles und humorvolles Team, regelmäßige Teamevents und viel Hands-on-Mentalität. Work-Life-Balance: 24 Urlaubstage und ein strukturiertes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld. KI & Tools: Zugang zu modernen Arbeitsmitteln und KI — damit du von Anfang an effizient arbeiten kannst. Vergütung: Pflichtpraktika werden bei uns mit 600 € pro Monat vergütet. Du erkennst dich in dieser Stelle wieder? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deine Immatrikulationsbescheinigung. Ein paar Zeilen dazu, was dich an Food und Produktentwicklung reizt, sind willkommen und helfen uns, dich besser kennenzulernen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Wir begrüßen ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung. Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. items.snippet: About us Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. As a Software Engineer Intern, Agent, you'll work directly on production AI agents for Sierra's customers. You'll gain hands-on experience contributing to the design and development of AI agents, shipping features, and learning from real-world use cases at scale. If you're hungry to shape and learn from the most important technological wave in history, come build at Sierra. Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. items.title: Growth Associate (Intern)
items.snippet: Who we are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR. What you will do Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team. Your first job is to turn organic reach into a machine: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter. On a typical day, your tasks may include: Creator network: finding and briefing creators at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver Launches: getting our products in front of the communities where they can travel, at the right moment Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from new communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers Who you are We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel. Typically, your profile will look like this: Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment A big plus: you are a creator yourself, with a real following Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it What makes this exciting You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. What the process will look like We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP. Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage: Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics Offer, contract signing and onboarding Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.snippet: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Bristol, UK<br><strong>Salary: </strong>£2500 per month<br><strong>Start date: </strong>June 2027<br><strong>Application deadline</strong>: Midnight, 29th November 2026 <br><em>We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.</em></p> <h3>The Internship Programme at Graphcore</h3> <p>Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.</p> <h3>What you’ll work on</h3> <p>Use your programming skills and curiosity to help AI models run efficiently on next-generation Graphcore hardware. </p> <p>In AI Compute Libraries & Performance, you’ll contribute to C++ libraries and compute kernels for machine learning workloads. Your work will include: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Developing compute kernels:</strong> Implement and improve operations such as matrix multiplication (GEMM), convolutions, reductions, elementwise operations and fused kernels that combine multiple operations. </li> <li><strong>Understanding and improving performance:</strong> Use profiling and microbenchmarks to measure execution speed and investigate how threading, cache locality, memory layout and kernel launch efficiency affect performance. </li> <li><strong>Checking correctness and reliability:</strong> Build regression tests and numerical checks, investigate issues and improve the quality of the libraries our customers use. </li> </ul> <p>Through these projects, you’ll develop practical experience connecting numerical computing with how code runs on hardware, helping deliver software that is fast, accurate and reliable. </p> <h3>Your team and support</h3> <p>You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. Our work brings together machine learning, numerical computing and accelerator performance, with colleagues sharing their expertise to solve engineering problems.</p> <p><span data-contrast="none">You’ll contribute to clearly scoped projects and build your skills with guidance from engineers working in performance and low-level software. Together, we use profiling, experiments and technical reviews to compare approaches, understand trade-offs and improve our solutions.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Your buddy will help you settle in, get familiar with our tools and ways of working, and find the right people to ask. Your manager will meet with you regularly to agree goals, offer feedback and discuss your development, including time for learning.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We welcome different perspectives and make space for everyone to contribute. Questions, alternative approaches and requests for help are part of how we work. As you take on more responsibility, your colleagues will help you work through challenges, and your ideas will be listened to and discussed respectfully.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h3>How you’ll learn and grow</h3> <p>Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build performance engineering skills through hands-on work on compute kernels, benchmarks and tests.<span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Profiling and experiments will help you understand where time is spent and how changes to code and data layout affect performance. Numerical validation and regression testing will show you how to check that an optimisation preserves correct results and continues to work as software changes.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Working with specialists and discussing technical trade-offs will help you develop your engineering judgement, explain your findings and connect mathematical operations to efficient implementations on hardware.</span></p> <h3>What we're looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Currently studying towards a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field</li> <li>Experience with C or C++11, plus familiarity with Python or scripting tools for automation and testing</li> <li>An understanding of linear algebra, numerical methods or scientific computing</li> <li>Problem-solving skills and collaborative approach to unfamiliar technical challenges</li> </ul> <p>Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us what you built or investigated through coursework, personal or team projects or other relevant experience, how you approached it and what you learned.</p> <p>Coursework or experience with machine learning frameworks, parallel programming, code optimisation, maths libraries or performance analysis would be useful. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Find a balance between your internship and life outside work</li> <li><strong>5 days of annual leave:</strong> Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship</li> <li><strong>Life in the office:</strong> Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista</li> <li><strong>Learning and development:</strong> Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3>Sponsorship</h3> <p>Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.</p> <h3>Introduction to Graphcore</h3> <p>At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: From semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier.<br>Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together.</p> <h3>How to apply and what to expect </h3> <p>To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring.</p> <p>Curious about where your skills could take you? <strong>Apply for a summer internship at Graphcore and help us build what comes next.</strong></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

items.title: Lab Automation Internship
items.snippet: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We're scaling our automated lab fast, and the automation team builds and maintains the work cells that make high-throughput biology possible — Hamilton liquid handlers, robot arms, plate readers, BLI/SPR instruments, all orchestrated by LabOS. We're looking for a Lab Automation Intern to work hands-on with that team in Lausanne: building and running automated protocols, helping bring new instruments online, and keeping production automation healthy. This is a practical, on-site role for someone who likes working where software meets hardware meets wet lab. You'll spend your time at the bench and the keyboard — programming liquid handlers, watching robots run, scripting small integrations, and figuring out why something broke. What You'll Do Help build and run automated liquid-handling protocols on our robots (Hamilton STAR and others), controlled in Python with open-source tooling like PyLabRobot / PyHamilton — with guidance from the automation team Support work-cell operation and maintenance: loading runs, swapping consumables, calibrating instruments, and troubleshooting when something jams or misreadsx Write real software in Python — instrument drivers, integrations, and tooling that controls hardware and moves data through LabOS, building on open-source libraries like PyLabRobot / PyHamilton Help reverse-engineer how an instrument talks — capturing its traffic (e.g. with Wireshark or a USB/serial sniffer) so we can control it in code Run tests on new protocols and instruments, record results carefully, and flag anomalies Document protocols, work-cell layouts, and fixes so the next person can reproduce them Pitch in on the physical side — wiring up a new device, organizing the work cell, prepping plates and reagents for automated runs What We're Looking For Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's in engineering, robotics, mechatronics, computer science, bioengineering, or a related field A generalist maker — you like building things, taking them apart, and figuring out why they don't work, across software, electronics, and mechanics Self-starter — you spot what needs doing and get on with it, rather than waiting to be told Solid software skills. This is a software-heavy role, not a lab-assistant gig. You write real Python — you can build a driver, structure code others can read, work with APIs and Git, and debug your way through someone else's library AI-native. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents. You use Claude Code (or similar) to write, debug, and ship software faster than you could by hand, and you're hungry to push how far that goes Organized and reliable — you keep good notes and don't let things slip through the cracks A background in biology isn't required, but you should find it genuinely cool that we're teaching robots to run biology experiments Bonus: any maker / hacker experience — 3D printing and CAD, electronics and soldering, microcontrollers (Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32), machining, robotics, or lab automation. Using or contributing to open-source projects (PyLabRobot, PyHamilton, Opentrons, or anything else) is a big plus. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site) Commitment: Full-time internship, minimum 3 months (longer preferred) Start date: ASAP Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment. As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement. Why Join Coalition Technologies? Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer: 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance Subsidized gym memberships Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses Office Assistant Responsibilities As an Office Assistant, your duties will include: Answering phones and emails Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars Required Skills and Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole Excellent verbal and written communication skills High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness Strong attention to detail and organizational skills Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers Preferred Skills The following experience is preferred but not required: Intermediate spreadsheet skills Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations Remote Work Environment Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world. Growth Opportunity This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments. items.title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
items.snippet: Location : 100% remote (Ohio residency required) Classification : Full-time, exempt Reports to : School Leader Pay Range : $40.00 - $48.00 per hour Welcome to Miaplaza! Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð Role Summary The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Instructional Staff Management Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting. Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers. Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback. Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback. Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals. Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences. Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations. Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed. Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes. Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law. Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together. Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns. Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track. Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas. Academic Data & Testing Coordination Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions. Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing. Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families. Professional Development Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data. Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team. Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities. Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues. Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations. Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments. Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices. Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â What We're Looking For Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026. Requirements: Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements At least 3 years of teaching experience At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems The Ideal Candidate Brings: Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school Compensation & Benefits The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour.
